chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Zakariyyā, the companion of al-Sābirī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Three are in al-jannah upon the most fragrant musk: a muʾadhdhin who gives the adhān seeking reward, an Imam who leads a people while they are pleased with him, and a bondsman who obeys Allah and obeys his masters.

key_terms.إِمَامٌ: the one who leads the people, here in prayer
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: al-jannah, the garden of eternal reward
key_terms.الْمِسْكِ الْأَذْفَرِ: the most fragrant musk, indicating honor and delight
key_terms.رَاضُونَ: being pleased and satisfied with his leadership
key_terms.مُؤَذِّنٌ: the one who calls the adhān
key_terms.يُطِيعُ اللَّهَ: he obeys Allah in his conduct and duties

ai.seo_question: Which people are promised a special rank in al-jannah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights three people promised an elevated station in al-jannah: the sincere caller to prayer, the accepted prayer leader, and the obedient bondsman. Its significance lies in combining sincerity in worship, righteous leadership, and faithful fulfillment of duty as qualities honored by Allah.
